ruling: maintainer ruling 2026-10-05 (D-319), item N4 (Monte-Carlo tolerance rule)
monte_carlo_rule: Monte-Carlo tolerance rule (maintainer ruling 2026-10-05, D-319, item N4; stated before any run in test/fixtures/gen_mc_simulate_p1.R, test/mc_simulate_helpers_p1.jl and test/test_mc_simulate_p1.jl): each engine draws B independent replicates; for moment k, tolerance = z * sqrt(s_R^2/B_k + s_J^2/B_k), with s the replicate standard deviations over B_k replicate values and z = quantile(Normal(), 1 - 0.01/(2K)) (two-sided Bonferroni over the K moments, familywise alpha 0.01); pass when |m_R - m_J| <= tolerance for every moment, and a discrimination control must fail the same rule.

discrimination_control.alternative: R simulate(fit, nsim = 400, seed = 78, condition_on_RE = TRUE) (draws given the fitted latent modes) against the Julia default

note: The row's question is the default of simulate(): R's simulate.gllvmTMB_multi defaults to condition_on_RE = FALSE (latent scores redrawn), and Julia's simulate(fit, n) also draws a fresh z ~ N(0, I) per unit. Poisson GLLVM (p = 5, n = 60, d = 1, unique = FALSE) fitted by each engine to the same counts (logLik R -518.1678377186709, Julia -518.1678377139525). Largest |m_R - m_J| / tolerance = 0.962 over 25 moments; the conditional R draws fail 10 of 25, so the comparison separates the two defaults.
what_this_is_not: R replicate moments are copied from the tracked fixture; Julia replicate moments are recomputed here with independent random streams. This is a distributional comparison, not a draw-for-draw replay: no random number is shared between the engines.

cases.julia_source: GLLVModels.simulate(fit::PoissonFit, n; rng) via mc_simulate_default_julia (test/mc_simulate_helpers_p1.jl), one Xoshiro(30_000) stream
cases.tolerance_source_line: @test all(vcat(d1, d2) .<= vcat(t1, t2))   # MC-RULE-ASSERT simulate_default
cases.tolerance_rule: Monte-Carlo tolerance rule (maintainer ruling 2026-10-05, D-319, item N4; stated before any run in test/fixtures/gen_mc_simulate_p1.R, test/mc_simulate_helpers_p1.jl and test/test_mc_simulate_p1.jl): each engine draws B independent replicates; for moment k, tolerance = z * sqrt(s_R^2/B_k + s_J^2/B_k), with s the replicate standard deviations over B_k replicate values and z = quantile(Normal(), 1 - 0.01/(2K)) (two-sided Bonferroni over the K moments, familywise alpha 0.01); pass when |m_R - m_J| <= tolerance for every moment, and a discrimination control must fail the same rule.
